description: Implementation of per-thread semaphore functions for synchronization, including thread blocking counters, wait, poke, and initialization routines, with conditional compilation based on low-level alloc support.

classes.name: PerThreadSem
classes.description: Class providing per-thread semaphore operations for thread synchronization.

methods.name: SetThreadBlockedCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter for blocked threads in the current thread's identity.

methods.name: GetThreadBlockedCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the blocked thread counter for the current thread's identity.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Updates the thread's ticker and potentially pokes the thread if it has been idle for too long.
